# Boat builders near Eastharbour, for a small cedar dinghy

## Summary
Five yards around Eastharbour and Westmere build small wooden boats to order [s1][s3]; two take a single dinghy commission [s2].

## Assumptions
- "Small" is read as under 3 m, rowed or sailed.
- Prices are as each yard's own page states them; none was confirmed by phone.

## Findings — Eastharbour

- **Pell & Daughters** builds lapstrake dinghies to order and quotes 14 weeks. [s1]
- **Quay Street Boatworks** repairs and builds clinker boats under 5 m. [s1]

## Findings — Westmere / Lowford

- **Lowford Wooden Boats** takes single commissions, cedar on oak. [s2]
- **Marsh Yard** lists only restoration work this season. [s3]

## Findings — Northgate

- **Harker Boats** builds a 2.7 m pram from a stock design. [s2]

## Suggested shortlist
- Ask Lowford first, then Pell & Daughters.
